column3: Immediate calibration of the ratio: weakness, patience, and divine enabling qualify numerical leverage.

Frames claimed non-understanding alongside calculated weakness and group protection.
Directly pairs individual fighting responsibility with urging believers toward combat.

A boundary case of blocked guidance, without the focus's specific lack-of-understanding mechanism.

Names divine support through victory and through the believers themselves.
Treats reconciliation of believers' hearts as a divinely enabled source of unity.

Presents fighting as a means by which God acts against opponents and relieves believers' hearts.

Addresses the inertia of being weighed down when called to go forth in God's way.
Warns that refusal to go forth brings replacement rather than harm to God's purpose.
Pairs apparently minimal human company with divine support, tranquility, and a superior word.
Commands going forth whether light or heavy and striving with wealth and selves.
Treats believers in God and the Last Day as not seeking leave to avoid striving.
Identifies preparation as the missing sign of genuine intention to go forth.
Frames the believers' possible outcomes as two goods, countering fear of battlefield loss.

Rejects a later offer to go forth from those who first preferred remaining behind.
Sets the Messenger and believers' striving with wealth and selves against those who stayed behind.

Treats hardship, thirst, exertion, and each advance against opponents as accounted good.
Commands fighting nearby disbelievers and displaying firmness in the encounter.

Connects support for God with divine support and describes protection of worshiping communities.
Recalls a coalition threat met by divine wind and unseen forces.
Depicts the acute physical and psychological pressure of encirclement.
Names that crisis as a severe testing and shaking of believers.
Recalls a prior covenant not to turn backs in flight.
Shows believers recognizing the gathered forces as a promise that increased faith and submission.
Presents believers who fulfilled their commitment, whether completed or still waiting.
Shows the collapse of an opposing group through fear after the coalition conflict.
Supplies conduct and purpose at direct battlefield encounter, though not the focus's ratio.
Reciprocally joins helping God's cause with divine help and firming believers' feet.
Names obedience and fitting speech at the point when fighting is decisively mentioned.
Forbids weakness and a call to peace while believers hold the upper position and God is with them.
Tests those left behind by a call to fight a people of great might.
States that if the disbelievers had fought believers, they would have turned back without protector or helper.
Establishes the constancy of God's way immediately after the battlefield counterfactual.
Links revealed measure and iron's severe strength to upholding justice and testing who supports God.
Commends those who fight in God's way as a unified, well-ordered rank.
Offers striving with wealth and selves as the path of profitable deliverance.
